title: Bitcoin — Logarithmic Regression
note: logreg-v2 · EXPANDING fit — every point uses only data that existed at that date. A full-sample fit would draw 2012's fair value using 2026 data. The dashed lines past today extend TODAY's fit and TODAY's residual spread forward; they are an extrapolation of the current fit and not a forecast, and they will move as the fit does.
subtitle: The fit widens and re-centres as history accumulates. Bands drawn in 2015 do not know 2021's spread.
